content:
Overview

Kortrijk is a city in West Flanders with a population of 77,000. A historic city in West Flanders with a well-preserved medieval center, thriving textile industry, and excellent shopping districts. Housing costs are close to the national average. The overall cost of living is below the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 5b growing zone supports Cool — many vegetables, some fruit trees. Reported crime rates are relatively low.
